To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the transverse momentum distributions of the jets in exclusive diffractive photoproduction are enhanced by a factor of 2 to 3 relative to the corresponding distribution in the inclusive case.
diffractive dijets are sensitive to the off-diagonal distribution of gluons, and that this distribution is enhanced at large x and small x by DGLAP and BFKL evolution, respectively.

the off-diagonal distribution is enhanced at high scales, the enhancement can be measured in exclusive dijet photoprodution, the enhancement is most pronounced at large rapidities and small x, and that the transverse momentum of the jets is a good measure of the scale of the enhancement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evolution of the parton distribution functions (PDFs) in the off-diagonal sector.
the evolution equations of the off-diagonals of the parton distribution functions (pdfs).
the off-diagonal structure of the gluon distribution and the role it plays in diffractive di-jet photoproduction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the off-diagonal distribution is not negligible and that it is a very interesting quantity to study in diffractive dijets.
the off-diagonal singlet and gluon distributions can be determined in a unique way from the diffractive dijets data.
the off-diagonal distribution is not only important, but is also a major part of the total distribution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
diffractive di-jet photoproduction is a very promising process to probe the off-diagonal structure of the gluon distribution.
the off-diagonal distribution is a key element in the description of the diffractive dijets.
the off-diagonal DGLAP evolution is a very strong effect and the off-diagonal ERBL effect is a very small effect in the region of the kinematics where the diffractive dijets are produced.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transverse momentum of the dijet system is an ideal probe of the off diagonal evolution.
exclusive dijet photoprodution is an ideal tool to probe the off-diagonal distribution of gluons and quarks in the proton.
diffractive dijets provide a unique probe of the off diagonal parton distributions.
